result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: truncated restaurant names in the horizontal carousel and a clipped promo badge on the pizza card.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis or full visibility, making the listing unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap to two lines, use ellipsis with full name on tap, or widen cards so names like 'Trattoria Piccolo' display completely.

issues.description: The '-20%' discount badge on the bottom pizza card is cut off on the left edge, so only part of the pill is visible.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent left padding/margin to promo badges so the full badge stays inside the card bounds.
